title: Membership under recoding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. If $u$ belongs to the $s$-window reachability set, then its recoded value belongs to the $(s+1)$-window reachability set.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
